title: Website inoita marii? (how much is a website)

shots.headline: How much does a website cost?
shots.line: Website inoita marii? How much does a website cost in Zimbabwe? Here's the honest answer.

shots.title: What changes the price
shots.headline: It depends on four things
shots.line: It depends on four things: how many pages you need, whether you take EcoCash or Paynow payments, if you want an online shop, and who writes the content.

shots.title: Plan for yearly costs
shots.headline: Ask about these up front
shots.line: Then plan for yearly costs: your .co.zw domain, hosting, and a business email.

shots.headline: No "inbox for price". A fixed quote, in writing.
shots.line: At iContact, there's no inbox for price. Tell us what you need, and we'll send you a fixed quote.
